observations: The lookup resolved PMCID PMC3257301 to PMID 22253597 and DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1002485.
The compact dataset record reported open-access status, a CC BY license, and PDF, XML, and text files.
The record reported neither retraction nor manuscript status.
Rosalind Workbench returned its ready task chooser for the recorded case-specific invocation.
interpretation: The record is a stable example of resolving one article across PMC, PubMed, and DOI identifiers while reporting machine-readable availability.
limitations: Availability is time-sensitive and should be rechecked before automated reuse.
The showcase checks metadata and file availability; it does not evaluate article content.
The Rosalind call opened only the task chooser and did not execute a scientific job.

actual_tools: public literature APIs and local Python
execution.implementation: dated PMC Article Dataset evidence, deterministic local availability summary, and a genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation

provenance.note: The PMC API produced the availability evidence; the separate Rosalind observation preserves the genuine task-chooser response and states that no scientific job ran.

reproduction: Run ncbi-pmc-skill for PMC3257301 and compare the versioned metadata with outputs/query-verification.json.
Check the retained open-access, license, manuscript, retraction, and file-availability fields independently.
Inspect the preview against outputs/results.json without treating file availability as article-quality evidence.
Compare any new Rosalind launcher response with outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json without treating it as a literature lookup.
